tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described traveling/moving through a dark tunnel “like twilight,” including reverse travel on return; also described progressive return of hearing then eyesight.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Met “a man that I knew to be Jesus” (no name given; identity known intuitively). Described as average height/weight, dark somewhat short hair, short dark beard, green eyes; light-colored roughly woven shirt and dark pants; extremely joyful/warm smile.
arrival.other_being_detail: During later repeated episodes, perceived other beings in the periphery during “number picking”: possibly “angels” or “teachers and guides,” interested in her choice; possible departed loved ones farther away but not clearly identified.

environment.environment_other_detail: “Vibrant, beyond beautiful field” with trees, shrubs, field grasses; “peace, contentment, freedom and love… everywhere.”

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return described as progressive: hearing returned first (heard nurses), then eyesight/light through eyelids, then “slipping back into my body,” followed by a “hard jolt.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sinus surgery under general anesthesia; described being “unresponsive for a very long time” though with vitals; also reported three subsequent repeat experiences during sleep over the next days while recovering.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Raised/educated in Catholic convent school (1st–8th grade).
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Recently returned to faith via a non-denominational/Protestant Bible study group; feared hell and prayed for comfort before surgery.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated episodes during sleep after surgery followed the same sequence (leave body → tunnel → bright light/field/encounter → return via tunnel with hearing then eyesight returning → re-entry with pain). Included a “number picking” episode with other beings in periphery.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Return described with sensory re-acquisition order (hearing then eyesight) before full bodily re-entry; episodes repeated on subsequent nights.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Same experience repeated during hospital sleep and on multiple nights at home after surgery (at least three repeats described, plus initial intraoperative episode).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: “How do you do a life?” question answered by Jesus with a simple gesture producing total comprehension (“full knowledge”). Later repeated episodes included being asked to “pick a number” (chose 9) with a perceived grid like an Excel spreadsheet; interpreted as relating to belief paths; reassurance that there are “no wrong choices.” Also reported telepathically hearing him say, “you won’t remember… you won’t remember” as knowledge faded upon return.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “how do you do a life” / “it’s so simple….. like this” / “you won’t remember… you won’t remember” / “it is, but you have been comforted”
